recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-full shot of a female subject in a gold sequined dress reclining against a chair, set against a saturated cobalt blue backdrop with high-contrast studio lighting and tech-inspired typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between the gold/yellow subject and the deep blue background
Diagonal composition created by the subject's reclining pose and the chair back
Juxtaposition of soft portraiture with sharp, geometric, futuristic lettering
coreInvariants: Gold sequined or metallic texture on clothing
High-contrast studio lighting with warm highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered but angled diagonally, filling approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright gold lettering in the top-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left text, down the subject's arm, across the sequined dress, and back up to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blue negative space concentrated in the upper-right and lower-left corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue background providing deep saturation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Gold and warm skin tones providing a bright, metallic contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta/Purple border on the right edge and orange-red accents in the logo blocks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background; high value contrast in the subject's highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blue, gold, and deep magenta

characterSpecificRedesigns: A-frame with a detached or stylized crossbar
E with three equal horizontal bars and no vertical stem on the right
G with a sharp, square inner hook
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Iconic geometric symbols paired with extended display type.
graphicDevices: Square logo blocks with internal letterforms
Shield-shaped emblem in the bottom-right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base geometric structure and horizontal width.
Captures the square-off corners and 90s tech feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman in a gold sequined dress reclining on a chair against a solid, saturated cobalt blue background. Use high-contrast lighting to emphasize the metallic texture of the dress.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom-lettered text in the top-left using an extra-extended, geometric gold font. Place square icon blocks above and below the text. Add a gold shield emblem in the bottom-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a deep, solid cobalt blue?
Is the dress texture distinctly metallic and sequined?
Is the typography extremely wide and geometric?
Is there a magenta border on the right edge?

adjustableVariables: Density of the sequins on the dress
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and brand logos
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast highlights on the sequins.
Ensure the blue background is vibrant and not navy.
Verify the text is horizontally extended and gold-colored.
Confirm the diagonal composition is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + Cobalt Blue Backdrop + Gold Sequined Wardrobe + Extended Geometric Typography = 90s R&B Aesthetic
